summary: Frontend-only testing of (a) sticky tab menu after scroll on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844), (b) adding a watch from the Live-flöde via the 'Bevaka' button updates 'Mina bevakningar' without page reload, and (c) adding a watch via the header 'Bevaka auktion' modal (keyword tab, 'borrmaskin') also shows up in 'Mina bevakningar' without reload. All three flows PASSED.

issues: Mixed Content warning: Tradera image URLs are served over http://img.tradera.net/... – browser auto-upgrades to HTTPS which may fail for some assets. Consider proxying or rewriting to https:// on the backend to avoid broken images and console warnings.

action_items: (Low priority) Normalize Tradera image URLs to https:// in backend crawler to avoid Mixed Content warnings in browser console.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has two useEffects that both call load() when view==='watch' (one via view dep, one implicit via load dep) – harmless but a tiny redundancy on initial mount. Not blocking.
LiveFeed polls every 10s; on 'watch' view, additionally load() is called – fine. Consider pausing live polling while in 'watch' view to save bandwidth (optional).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sticky nav verified at y=64 on both desktop and mobile after scrolling 1200px. Watch-count tab badge updates reactively (3 -> 4) and 'Mina bevakningar' grid shows newly added cards without reload. The AddAuctionModal has data-testid 'add-auction-modal' with tabs 'tab-url' / 'tab-keyword', inputs under keyword tab, submit button 'submit-auction'. Backend created a borrmaskin watch in <8s. Only cosmetic console warning observed: Mixed Content from http://img.tradera.net/ image sources.
rca of the issue: N/A – both reported bugs (sticky tab menu missing on scroll; new bevakning requiring page reload) are confirmed fixed. Sticky achieved via <header className='sticky top-0 z-40'> containing both header and view-toggle rows. Reactive update achieved by passing onWatchAdded={load} from App → LiveFeed, so after api.liveWatch succeeds LiveFeed calls parent load() which refetches auctions+stats; additionally App has a useEffect reloading when view switches to 'watch'.
